units.source_text: 薰中纳言闻知此事，对二女公子深感同情，

en.t: When Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, heard of this, he felt deep sympathy for the Second Princess,

units.source_text: 他想：“匂亲王乃好色之徒，容易变心，虽然怜爱二女公子，今后势必得新忘旧。

en.t: and thought, "Prince Niou is a sensual man and easily changes his heart; though he loves the Second Princess, from now on he is bound to forget the old for the new.

units.source_text: 左大臣家势威显赫，如果不讲道理，硬把新婿独占，

en.t: The Left Minister's household is powerful and imposing; if they act unreasonably and forcibly keep the new son-in-law all to themselves,

units.source_text: 则近几月来不惯独宿的二女公子，今后坐待天明之夜定然很多，真可怜呢。

en.t: then the Second Princess, who these past months has not been used to sleeping alone, will surely have many nights ahead of her sitting up until dawn. How pitiful she is.

units.source_text: 如此想来，我这个人多么不中用啊！

en.t: Thinking of it this way, how useless I am!

units.source_text: 怎么会把这二女公子让给了匂亲王呢？

en.t: How could I have handed this Second Princess over to Prince Niou?

units.source_text: 我自从钟情于已故的大女公子之后，远离尘世而清澄皎洁的心也变成浑浊，

en.t: Ever since I fell in love with the late Elder Princess, even my clear, bright heart, once removed from worldly things, has become clouded,

units.source_text: 只管为了这个人而意马心猿。

en.t: and for her alone my mind has been restless and unsettled.

units.source_text: 我毕竟顾虑到：如果在她未曾心许之时强要成事，

en.t: After all, I was worried that if I forced matters before she had given her heart,

units.source_text: 则违背了我当初指望神交的本意，

en.t: I would be betraying my original wish for a bond of the spirit,

units.source_text: 所以只希望她稍怀好感、开诚解怀地对待我，然后静待将来发展。

en.t: so I only hoped she would come to feel some affection, open her heart to me sincerely, and then I would quietly wait for what might come.

units.source_text: 但她一面对我非常冷淡，一面又不能全然舍弃我，

en.t: But while she was very cold toward me, she also could not completely cast me aside,

units.source_text: 为了慰情，以‘妹妹即是我身’为由，

en.t: and to console my feelings, saying that her younger sister was the same as herself,

units.source_text: 叫我把爱情移向非我所望的二女公子。

en.t: she made me turn my love toward the Second Princess, whom I had not desired.

units.source_text: 我既怨且恨，思量首先要使她的计谋落空，

en.t: Both resentful and bitter, I thought first of making her scheme come to nothing,

units.source_text: 便急忙把二女公子推荐给了匂亲王。

en.t: and so I hurriedly recommended the Second Princess to Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 由于优柔寡断，鬼迷心窍，竟引导匂亲王到宇治来成就其事。

en.t: Because I was indecisive and deluded, I even guided Prince Niou to Uji and let him accomplish the affair.

units.source_text: 现在回想起来，当时好没主意啊！

en.t: Looking back now, how thoughtless I was then!

units.source_text: 反复思量，不胜后悔。

en.t: The more I turn it over in my mind, the more unbearable my regret becomes.

units.source_text: 匂亲王倘多少能够回忆当时情况，我想他也许会怕我闻知此事而有所顾忌。

en.t: If Prince Niou could recall even a little of what happened then, I think he might fear that I would learn of this and show some restraint.

units.source_text: 然而罢了！

en.t: But enough of that!

units.source_text: 他现在绝不会说起当时的事情了。

en.t: He would never speak of those days now.

units.source_text: 可见耽好色情、容易变心的人，不但使女子受累，朋友也大上其当。

en.t: This shows that men who are absorbed in love affairs and quick to change their hearts not only make women suffer, but also badly deceive their friends.

units.source_text: 他自然会做出轻薄的行径来。”

en.t: He is naturally bound to behave in a frivolous way."

units.source_text: 他痛恨匂亲王。

en.t: He bitterly hated Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言性喜专爱一人，故对别人的这种行为深感不满。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, was by nature inclined to love one person alone, and so he felt deep displeasure at such behavior in others.

units.source_text: 他又想：“自从那人去世之后，皇上有意将公主赐我，我也不觉得特别欣喜。

en.t: He thought again, "Since that person died, even when the Emperor intended to grant me a princess, I did not feel especially pleased.

units.source_text: 我但望娶得二女公子，此心与日俱增，

en.t: I only wished to marry the Second Princess, and that feeling grew stronger day by day,

units.source_text: 只因她与死者有骨肉之缘，使我不能忘怀也。

en.t: simply because she was bound by blood to the dead woman, and that made it impossible for me to forget her.

units.source_text: 世间姐妹之中，这二人特别亲爱。

en.t: Among sisters in this world, those two were especially close and loving.

units.source_text: 大女公子临终前曾对我说：‘我所遗下的妹妹，请你与我同样看待。’

en.t: Before she died, the Elder Princess said to me, 'Please regard the younger sister I leave behind just as you would regard me.'

units.source_text: 又说：‘我一生别无不称心之事。

en.t: She also said, 'In my whole life, there has been nothing else that failed to satisfy me.

units.source_text: 只是你不曾照我的安排娶得我妹，实甚遗憾，

en.t: Only that you did not marry my sister as I had arranged is truly a great regret,

units.source_text: 故对这世间尚有挂念耳。’

en.t: and because of that I still have an attachment to this world.'

units.source_text: 大女公子在天之灵如果看到今日之事，定将恨我更深了。”

en.t: If the Elder Princess's spirit in heaven sees what has happened today, she will surely hate me even more deeply."

units.source_text: 他自己放弃了那人，夜夜抱枕独眠，听到一点儿风声就惊醒。

en.t: He himself had given that person up, and night after night he slept alone clutching his pillow, waking at the slightest sound of wind.

units.source_text: 仔细思量过去之事以及二女公子将来之计，

en.t: As he carefully considered the events of the past and what might become of the Second Princess,

units.source_text: 但觉人生在世毫无意趣。

en.t: he felt only that life in this world had no interest at all.
